rationale: Vectorised EMA via torch._foreach_mul_/add_ on pre-collected flat param/shadow list (iter-25 timed out with naive named_parameters loop). EMA decay=0.999 from ep0 over 6 epochs.
advice_for_others: EMA starting from ep0 with decay=0.999 REGRESSES NAFNet by 4.4pp (0.5762 -> 0.5322). With zero-init head, the shadow is initialised to identity-equivalent weights, and 6 epochs * 400 steps = 2400 updates / half-life 693 leaves ~9% initial-weight contribution. The shadow gets pulled back toward the (no-denoising) identity map. Next: try ema_start_ep>=3 to only average mature weights, OR use SWA over only the last 1-2 epochs. Vectorised foreach EMA itself is fast enough (315s total vs iter-21 323s — actually a hair faster than baseline).
